```sql
    FROM case_data cd
```

        json_extract_string(pw.wage_details, '$.prevailing_wage.level') AS wage_level,
        CASE
            WHEN v.emcv = 1 THEN '1'
            WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
            WHEN v.emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
            WHEN v.emcv >= 15 THEN '15+'
        END AS monthly_volume_band
    FROM case_months cm
    LEFT JOIN case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = cm.filekey
    LEFT JOIN prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
    LEFT JOIN volumes v
        ON v.homefirm = cm.homefirm
       AND v.start_month = date_trunc('month', cm.start_date)
    WHERE cm.start_date >= DATE '2023-12-01'
      AND cm.start_date < DATE '2024-01-01'
),
matches AS (
    SELECT
        cd.filekey,
        r.rule_id,
        r.base_hours,
        r.position_hours,
        (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER AS specificity
    FROM case_data cd
    JOIN review_schedule r
      ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = cd.visacls)
     AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = cd.wage_level)
     AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = cd.h1bdep)
     AND (r.soc_major_group IS NULL OR r.soc_major_group = substr(cd.soccd, 1, 2))
     AND (r.worksite_state IS NULL OR r.worksite_state = cd.wsstate)
     AND (r.monthly_volume_band IS NULL OR r.monthly_volume_band = cd.monthly_volume_band)
),
governing AS (

    FROM matches
    QUALIFY row_number() OVER (
        PARTITION BY filekey
        ORDER BY specificity DESC, rule_id ASC
    ) = 1
),

    SELECT
        cd.filekey,
        CASE
            WHEN g.rule_id IS NULL THEN 3.50 + 0.50 * cd.headct
            ELSE g.base_hours + g.position_hours * cd.headct
        END AS crh,

    FROM case_data cd

)
SELECT round(
    100.0 * sum(crh) FILTER (WHERE rule_id IS NULL) / sum(crh),

FROM hours;

```sql
WITH case_attrs AS (
  SELECT
    c.filekey,
    c.homefirm,
    c.headct,
    CAST(c.visacls AS TEXT) AS visa_class,
    pw.wage_details->'prevailing_wage'->>'level' AS wage_level,
    CAST(c.h1bdep AS TEXT) AS h1b_dependent,
    substr(c.soccd, 1, 2) AS soc_major_group,
    cw.wsstate AS worksite_state,
    date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y')) AS start_month,
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY c.homefirm,
                   date_trunc('month', strptime(c.beginday, '%d/%m/%Y'))
    ) AS emcv
  FROM main.cases c
  JOIN main.case_worksite cw ON cw.dockkey = c.filekey
  JOIN main.prevailing_wage pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
),
banded AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN emcv = 1 THEN '1'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 2 AND 4 THEN '2-4'
      WHEN emcv BETWEEN 5 AND 14 THEN '5-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS monthly_volume_band
  FROM case_attrs
),
ranked_rules AS (
  SELECT
    b.filekey,
    r.rule_id,
    r.base_hours,
    r.position_hours,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY b.filekey
      ORDER BY (
        (r.visa_class IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.wage_level IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.soc_major_group IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.worksite_state IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
        + (r.monthly_volume_band IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER
      ) DESC,
      r.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM banded b
  JOIN main.review_schedule r
    ON (r.visa_class IS NULL OR r.visa_class = b.visa_class)
   AND (r.wage_level IS NULL OR r.wage_level = b.wage_level)
   AND (r.h1b_dependent IS NULL OR r.h1b_dependent = b.h1b_dependent)

  FROM banded b
  LEFT JOIN ranked_rules rr
    ON rr.filekey = b.filekey

)
```

                    + (r.h1b_dependent IS NOT NULL)::INTEGER

```sql
    0.7 * (100 * LEAST(GREATEST((wages.aow - wages.apw) / wages.apw, 0), 0.40) / 0.40)
      + 0.3 * CASE wages.wage_level
          WHEN 'I' THEN 25

          WHEN 'III' THEN 75

  JOIN main.prevailing_wage AS pw ON pw.trackno = cw.wagetrack
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
```

```sql
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 15.00 ELSE ar.flat_charge END
    + CASE WHEN ar.rule_id IS NULL THEN 5.0 ELSE ar.charge_pct END / 100.0 * CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS total_rhc
FROM main.returns r
JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT x.casenum, x.rule_id, x.flat_charge, x.charge_pct, x.specificity
  FROM (
    SELECT r2.casenum, cr.rule_id, cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct,
      (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specificity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r2.casenum ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r2
    JOIN main.orders o2 ON o2.txnnum = r2.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c2 ON c2.profilenum = o2.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p2 ON p2.itemcode = r2.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q2 ON q2.inspectref = r2.casenum
    JOIN (
      SELECT o3.buyerlink AS cust, substr(r3.revdate, 1, 7) AS mon, COUNT(*) AS cmrc
      FROM main.returns r3
      JOIN main.orders o3 ON o3.txnnum = r3.srctxn
      GROUP BY o3.buyerlink, substr(r3.revdate, 1, 7)
    ) m2 ON m2.cust = o2.buyerlink AND m2.mon = substr(r2.revdate, 1, 7)
    JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr ON
      (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = c2.seg_category)
      AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = r2.return_channel)
      AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = p2.itemcategory)
      AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (r2.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
      AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (q2.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
      AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m2.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
      AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m2.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
  ) x
  WHERE x.rn = 1
) ar ON ar.casenum = r.casenum
WHERE o.buyerlink = 'CUS00032'
  AND substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) = '2025-01';
```

                    + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
```sql
                    + CASE
                        WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
```
```sql
                          OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                        THEN 1 ELSE 0

                ) DESC,
                cr.rule_id ASC
```

```sql
    LEFT JOIN return_charge_rules cr
```

```sql
),
```

    GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
```sql
), ranked_rules AS (
    SELECT r.casenum,
           cr.rule_id,
           cr.flat_charge,
           cr.charge_pct,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY r.casenum
               ORDER BY (
                   CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
                 + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
               ) DESC, cr.rule_id ASC
           ) AS rn
    FROM main.returns r
    JOIN main.orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
    LEFT JOIN main.customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
    JOIN main.products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
    LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
    JOIN monthly_returns m
      ON m.customer_id = o.buyerlink

    JOIN main.return_charge_rules cr
      ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = c.seg_category)
     AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = r.return_channel)
     AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = p.itemcategory)
     AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason = (r.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
     AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition = (q.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
     AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
     AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR m.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
), applying_rule AS (
```

```sql
    COUNT(*) OVER (
      PARTITION BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
```
```sql
    ) AS cmrc,
    r.revdate,
    r.return_channel,
    r.return_details,
    p.itemcategory,
    CAST(p.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS unit_value,
    c.seg_category,
    q.assessment_summary
  FROM main.returns AS r
  JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  LEFT JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
  JOIN main.products AS p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  LEFT JOIN main.quality_assessment AS q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
),
matching AS (
  SELECT
    x.casenum,
    cr.rule_id,
    cr.flat_charge,
    cr.charge_pct,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY x.casenum
      ORDER BY
        (CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         + CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                  OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC,
        cr.rule_id ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM cmrc AS x
  JOIN main.return_charge_rules AS cr
    ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = x.seg_category)
   AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = x.return_channel)
   AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = x.itemcategory)
   AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL

   AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL
        OR cr.item_condition = (x.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
   AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR x.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)

),
charged AS (

    m.rule_id,

  FROM cmrc AS x
  LEFT JOIN matching AS m
    ON m.casenum = x.casenum AND m.rn = 1

FROM charged
```

```sql
WITH monthly_counts AS (
```
```sql
  SELECT o.buyerlink AS customer_id, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7) AS return_month, COUNT(*) AS cmrc
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  GROUP BY o.buyerlink, substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
), return_base AS (
  SELECT r.casenum, r.revdate, r.return_channel, r.return_details,
         o.buyerlink, c.seg_category, p.itemcategory, p.unit_value,
         q.assessment_summary, m.cmrc
  FROM returns r
  JOIN orders o ON o.txnnum = r.srctxn
  LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.profilenum = o.buyerlink
  JOIN products p ON p.itemcode = r.itemlink
  LEFT JOIN quality_assessment q ON q.inspectref = r.casenum
  JOIN monthly_counts m
    ON m.customer_id = o.buyerlink
   AND m.return_month = substr(r.revdate, 1, 7)
), ranked_matches AS (
  SELECT b.casenum, cr.rule_id, cr.flat_charge, cr.charge_pct,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY b.casenum
           ORDER BY (
             CASE WHEN cr.customer_segment IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN cr.return_channel IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN cr.item_category IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN cr.primary_reason IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN cr.item_condition IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
             CASE WHEN cr.min_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL
                    OR cr.max_monthly_returns IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
           ) DESC,
           cr.rule_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM return_base b
  JOIN return_charge_rules cr
    ON (cr.customer_segment IS NULL OR cr.customer_segment = b.seg_category)
   AND (cr.return_channel IS NULL OR cr.return_channel = b.return_channel)
   AND (cr.item_category IS NULL OR cr.item_category = b.itemcategory)
   AND (cr.primary_reason IS NULL OR cr.primary_reason =
        (b.return_details->>'$.reasoning.primary_reason'))
   AND (cr.item_condition IS NULL OR cr.item_condition =
        (b.assessment_summary->>'$.condition.item_condition'))
   AND (cr.min_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc >= cr.min_monthly_returns)
   AND (cr.max_monthly_returns IS NULL OR b.cmrc <= cr.max_monthly_returns)
), winning_rules AS (
  SELECT casenum, flat_charge, charge_pct
  FROM ranked_matches
  WHERE rn = 1
), per_return AS (
  SELECT b.seg_category,
         COALESCE(w.flat_charge, 15.00)
           + COALESCE(w.charge_pct, 5.0) / 100.0 * CAST(b.unit_value AS DOUBLE) AS rhc
  FROM return_base b
  LEFT JOIN winning_rules w ON w.casenum = b.casenum
  WHERE substr(b.revdate, 1, 4) = '2025'
    AND b.seg_category IN ('Retail', 'Wholesale')
)
SELECT seg_category, ROUND(AVG(rhc), 2) AS avg_rhc
FROM per_return
GROUP BY seg_category
ORDER BY seg_category;
```

```sql
WITH ws AS (
  WITH snap AS (
    SELECT
      r.snapkey,
      r.snapts,
      COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
      m.makertag,
      m.pnlkind,
      a.alrtstate,
      p.warrstate,
      CASE
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
        WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
      END AS cap_band,
      COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
      ) AS claim_volume,
      COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ),
  tiered AS (
    SELECT
      snap.snapkey,
      snap.snapts,
      snap.maker_group,
      snap.makertag,
      snap.pnlkind,
      snap.alrtstate,
      snap.warrstate,
      snap.cap_band,
      snap.claim_volume,
      snap.replcost,
      CASE
        WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
        WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Bulk'
      END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      t.snapkey,
      w.rule_id,
      w.fixed_fee_usd,
      w.cover_pct,
```

```sql
SELECT ROUND(AVG(ws.settle_fee + ws.settle_cover_pct / 100.0 * ws.replcost), 2) AS avg_settlement_usd
FROM (
  WITH snap AS (
```
```sql
    SELECT
      r.snapkey,
      r.snapts,
      COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted') AS maker_group,
      m.makertag,
      m.pnlkind,
      a.alrtstate,
      p.warrstate,
      CASE
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 100 THEN 'Small'
        WHEN p.cap_mw < 300 THEN 'Mid'
        WHEN p.cap_mw >= 300 THEN 'Large'
      END AS cap_band,
      COUNT(r.snapkey) OVER (
        PARTITION BY COALESCE(m.makertag, 'Unlisted'), date_trunc('month', r.snapts)
      ) AS claim_volume,
      COALESCE(o.replcost, 0) AS replcost
    FROM main.plant_record r
    JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
    JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
    LEFT JOIN main.alert a ON a.snapalrt = r.snapkey
    LEFT JOIN main.operational_metrics o ON o.snapops = r.snapkey
  ),
  tiered AS (
    SELECT
      snap.snapkey,
      snap.snapts,
      snap.maker_group,
      snap.makertag,
      snap.pnlkind,
      snap.alrtstate,
      snap.warrstate,
      snap.cap_band,
      snap.claim_volume,
      snap.replcost,
      CASE
        WHEN snap.claim_volume = 1 THEN 'Single'
        WHEN snap.claim_volume <= 3 THEN 'Moderate'
        ELSE 'Bulk'
      END AS vol_tier
    FROM snap
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT
      t.snapkey,
      w.rule_id,
      w.fixed_fee_usd,
      w.cover_pct,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY t.snapkey
        ORDER BY
          (
            CASE WHEN w.maker_tag IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.pnl_kind IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.alrt_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.warr_state IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.cap_band IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN w.vol_tier IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
          ) DESC,
          w.rule_id
      ) AS rn
    FROM tiered t
    JOIN main.warranty_settle_rules w
      ON (w.maker_tag IS NULL OR w.maker_tag = t.makertag)
     AND (w.pnl_kind IS NULL OR w.pnl_kind = t.pnlkind)
     AND (w.alrt_state IS NULL OR w.alrt_state = t.alrtstate)
     AND (w.warr_state IS NULL OR w.warr_state = t.warrstate)
     AND (w.cap_band IS NULL OR w.cap_band = t.cap_band)
     AND (w.vol_tier IS NULL OR w.vol_tier = t.vol_tier)
  )
  SELECT
    t.snapkey,
    t.snapts,
    t.maker_group,
    t.makertag,
    t.pnlkind,
    t.alrtstate,
    t.warrstate,
    t.cap_band,
    t.claim_volume,
    t.vol_tier,
    t.replcost,
    g.rule_id,
    COALESCE(g.fixed_fee_usd, 300.00) AS settle_fee,
    COALESCE(g.cover_pct, 5.00) AS settle_cover_pct
  FROM tiered t
  LEFT JOIN ranked g ON g.snapkey = t.snapkey AND g.rn = 1
) ws
WHERE ws.pnlkind = 'HJT'
  AND ws.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00'
```

```sql
WITH snapshot_yields AS (
  SELECT
```
```sql
    pm.pnlkind,
    pr.snapts,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.energy_yield_kwh') AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.energy_yield.availability_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(ep.elec_perf_snapshot, '$.efficiency.soil_loss_pct') AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
  FROM plant_record pr
  JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
  JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
  JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
),
potential AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    snapts,
    energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0)) AS potential_kwh,
    energy_kwh
  FROM snapshot_yields
  WHERE energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
    AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
    AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(potential_kwh - energy_kwh) AS total_loss_kwh,

  WHERE pnlkind = 'TOPCon'
    AND snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2021-05-01 00:00:00'
    AND snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-06-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * total_loss_kwh / total_potential_kwh, 2) AS loss_ratio_pct
FROM monthly;
```

)

```sql
WITH snapshot_energy AS (
  SELECT
    m.pnlkind,
    strftime(r.snapts, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
               * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100), 0) AS e_pot,
    (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE
      / NULLIF(((e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'availability_pct')::DOUBLE / 100)
               * (1 - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'efficiency'->>'soil_loss_pct')::DOUBLE / 100), 0)
      - (e.elec_perf_snapshot->'energy_yield'->>'energy_yield_kwh')::DOUBLE AS e_loss
  FROM main.plant_record r
  JOIN main.plants p ON r.sitetie = p.sitekey
  JOIN main.panel_models m ON p.modhook = m.modkey
  JOIN main.electrical_performance e ON e.snaplink = r.snapkey
  WHERE r.snapts >= TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01'
    AND r.snapts < TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01'
),
technology_month AS (
  SELECT
    pnlkind,
    month,
    SUM(e_pot) AS total_potential,
    SUM(e_loss) AS technology_recoverable_energy,
    100 * SUM(e_loss) / NULLIF(SUM(e_pot), 0) AS loss_ratio
  FROM snapshot_energy
  GROUP BY pnlkind, month
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100 * SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN loss_ratio >= 14 THEN technology_recoverable_energy
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) / NULLIF(SUM(technology_recoverable_energy), 0),
    2
  ) AS severe_share_pct
FROM technology_month;
```

```sql
        snapkey,
        pnlkind,
```

The monthly bands are calculated from all available snapshots in each technology-month; the comparison then selects snapshots taken in 2021.

```sql
WITH snapshot_yields AS (
    SELECT
        pr.snapkey,
        pr.snapts,
        pm.pnlkind,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot -> 'energy_yield' ->> 'energy_yield_kwh' AS DOUBLE) AS energy_kwh,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot -> 'energy_yield' ->> 'availability_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS availability_pct,
        CAST(ep.elec_perf_snapshot -> 'efficiency' ->> 'soil_loss_pct' AS DOUBLE) AS soil_loss_pct
    FROM plant_record pr
    JOIN plants p ON p.sitekey = pr.sitetie
    JOIN panel_models pm ON pm.modkey = p.modhook
    JOIN electrical_performance ep ON ep.snaplink = pr.snapkey
),
potential AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN energy_kwh IS NOT NULL
             AND availability_pct IS NOT NULL
             AND soil_loss_pct IS NOT NULL
             AND availability_pct <> 0
             AND soil_loss_pct <> 100
            THEN energy_kwh / ((availability_pct / 100.0) * (1.0 - soil_loss_pct / 100.0))
        END AS potential_kwh
    FROM snapshot_yields
),
with_losses AS (
    SELECT *, potential_kwh - energy_kwh AS loss_kwh
    FROM potential
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        pnlkind,
        date_trunc('month', snapts) AS snap_month,
        100.0 * sum(loss_kwh) / nullif(sum(potential_kwh), 0) AS loss_ratio_pct
    FROM with_losses
    GROUP BY pnlkind, date_trunc('month', snapts)
),
bands AS (
    SELECT *,
        CASE
            WHEN loss_ratio_pct < 6 THEN 'Low'
            WHEN loss_ratio_pct >= 14 THEN 'Severe'
        END AS loss_band
    FROM monthly
),
selected AS (
    SELECT w.snapkey, b.loss_band, w.loss_kwh
    FROM with_losses w
    JOIN bands b
      ON b.pnlkind IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.pnlkind
     AND b.snap_month = date_trunc('month', w.snapts)
    WHERE extract(year FROM w.snapts) = 2021
      AND b.loss_band IN ('Low', 'Severe')
),
requested_bands AS (
    SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('Low'), ('Severe')) AS v(loss_band)
)
SELECT
    rb.loss_band,
    count(s.snapkey) AS snapshots,
    round(avg(s.loss_kwh), 2) AS avg_loss_kwh
FROM requested_bands rb
LEFT JOIN selected s ON s.loss_band = rb.loss_band
GROUP BY rb.loss_band
ORDER BY CASE rb.loss_band WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;
```

 )
